svg.title: TOPAK H3 — Verification map: what is checked, what is proved, what must fail, and what neither claims
svg.desc: Every check and proof in the corpus at G12 and Batch 40. Three methods, three words (ADR-0046 §1, A1): TLC checks forty-one TLA+ modules at small constants, each mutation failing the property it targets and each reachability witness violated; the TLA+ Proof System proves the invariants of thirty-four of them, 13,622 obligations, under named assumptions and the absence of the mutations that break each (G12 §2.9); and thirty-one of those proofs are certified, every SMT obligation backed by a proof an independent checker accepted (H6), by a prover known to be unsound in two ways that a rule and a scan keep proofs from (ADR-0046 A2, B37), both reported upstream (B39) and the pin unmoved (G12 §2.6). Liveness is checked, not proved (E4). Ten of the thirty-four proofs are of Proposed records: the two workflow modules, proved and certified since 2026.11.11 (ADR-0054 R7, ADR-0055 R3; C9, D6), and the command-chain overlay's eight, of a design with no floor and no code (H8). The consensus log is modelled since 2026.11.14, checked and trace-validated, not proved (ADR-0033 A20, B40). Then the policy floor's gates, run on the genesis floor and on the proposed floor's four stages, the last of which the reference links and is not in force; the reference's 159 tests restating the properties; the trace harness that replays those tests through an operational model, which found a race no proof could and is behind the tree since the workflow build; the drift pins; and the lineage gate suite. Then the honesty layer: a proof is of the module, a certified proof is not a verified one, and what runs is neither checked nor proved. Beside them, ratified in Batch 36 (ADR-0053; H7), a second route in Lean: fifteen proof modules' theorems proved again of re-encodings, the admit decision proved a step of FloorComposition, two models of apply replayed against the traces, and the floors' totality under Cedar's verified model; unchanged since, and stale (G12 item 103).

text.tspan: 1 · Six chains of evidence, from the record to the running code; the third is in Lean

svg.text: The ADRs state each property against what an agent's
alphabet allows. A module is cited by digest in the accepted
record it checks; a change is a successor module, suffix _A1
(G10 §5): Lease_A1, Confinement_A1, and since
2026.10.05 BreakGlass_A1 and NonComposition_A1,
where the predecessors model X1.
Each property with a mutation that must fail and a Never…
witness that must be violated (non-vacuity, G2 §3):
existential claims, checked. Small constants;
tools/tla2tools.jar 1.7.4, TLC 2.19, tracked for its digest
(T-0045-29) and since G12 pinned in tools/TLA-PIN (G12
§2.6). G9's twenty, seven at G10, four at G11 (two liveness
extensions, whose leads-to properties TLC checks;
Workflow and Mesh), the command-chain overlay's eight
(2026.11.10, Proposed; H8), and Paxos with PaxosTrace
(2026.11.14, A20, B40). The invariants of 34 are also proved
(lane 2); Paxos's are not.
mechanism/: 159 tests (36269bc, ADR-0033 A20, B40:
A19's 155 across fifteen binaries and four in topak-paxos's
simulation) and 38 Rego tests (A15's, not rerun since), each
named for the property and the mutation it refuses (GAPS
§6; operators.rs, emergency.rs and the two
workflow.rs named for the modules' properties). The
workflow build is still A16's and A17's, pending (R14).
Discrimination tests, not proofs, by the same hand.
Tests record every apply; trace2tla.py converts;
Mechanism.tla replays and checks TraceMatches. 21
traces (09.30); 62 traces, 709 steps (10.02b); 82 traces,
1,007 steps, every step matching (10.05, A14), every state
also read against ConfinementRefinement.tla. Checked
to discriminate; it found a race in lease expiry (A13). Behind
the tree since 2026.10.08: Mechanism.tla does not model
workflows, and it was not rerun at A16, A19 or A20; the self
review's rerun matched 82 of 83 traces, the end-to-end
workflow run excepted (G12 item 56). The consensus log
has the same since 2026.11.14: PaxosTrace.tla replays
the simulation's recorded runs, 8 traces, 3,302 events, every
line as expected, run twice (A20, B40). Since 2026.10.06 the
same traces also run through a Lean model of apply's seat
and lease arms: 82 traces, 1,014 steps, every one a model
step (ADR-0053 R4, B36), and through a second model that
adds sequence numbers, watermarks and seals (R5); both
stale since the workflow build (G12 item 103).
What no test reaches is asserted, and the model takes more
from the trace than it did: whether a request's signature is its
seat's, whether a sign-on assertion verifies, which roster keys
approved an activation, which seat a revocation was lifted on
(G10 §3). The floor's decision on an operator's request is not
modelled. T-0045-28 stays a trust root.
With differential testing against the code (ADR-0033 open
obligations; G12 item 56). Not begun. The proofs make its
target precise and do nothing else for it (ADR-0046 §2). Two
functions are proved in Lean of a transcription (ADR-0053,
B36; lane 3): evidence for those functions, not a model of
apply, and not stage 2.
The Lean model compiled; with a reproducible build
(T-0045-30), the rows leave Annex A only on the addendum
that cites the chain. Not begun.
Cited by digest in a record. Thirty-four have a proof (G12
§2.9): every module but Mechanism.tla (a trace replay),
ConfinementRefinement.tla (predicates over its replayed
states), Lease.tla (its invariants are Lease_A1's),
RulesFloorNV.tla (superseded by rev 5),
RulesFloorBase.tla (definitions), and since A20
Paxos.tla (its safety argument is Voting's, not written as a
module) and PaxosTrace.tla (a trace replay): seven
reasons in proof-sync.sh, which exits 0. Workflow and
Mesh are proved since 2026.11.11 (ADR-0054 R7,
ADR-0055 R3), their records Proposed.
Extends the module without editing it. Each invariant as
Spec => []P; its hypothesis is only the mutations that break
it; a combined Safe under Mut = "none"; one lemma per
mutation saying what it admits.

text.tspan: Accepted · C2, C4 · B25, B37, B39

svg.text: tlapm 1.6.0-pre at 7824dab (binary e150fb793fb28592…)
with Z3 4.8.9, Zenon 0.8.4, Isabelle2025, LS4; installed by
tools/install-tlaps.sh, not tracked, pinned by
tools/TLAPS-PIN and run through tools/tlapm, which
refuses another digest (G10 item 73, discharged). Known
unsound in two ways (ADR-0046 A2): a term under a
binder; two terms with one name. A rule and proof-scan.sh
keep a proof from them; no check detects the first. Both
reported upstream (A3, ADR-0045 A4, B39) and fixed
upstream in part, in ff40755; the pin has both (G12 §2.6,
item 104).
proof-results.sh regenerates each, printing the digest of
every module in the EXTENDS chain and of the prover.
13,622 obligations, every one proved (G12 §2.9): G11's
twenty-four still sum to 5,416 (G9's fifteen at 10.02, five at
10.04, the two successors at 10.05, the two liveness
extensions at 10.07 and 10.08); the overlay's eight at 11.10
(5,600) and Workflow and Mesh at 11.11 (1,136 and 1,470).
proof-cert.sh reruns each with Z3 replaced by cvc5
behind smt-checked, every unsat counted only on a proof
ethos accepted, and Zenon checked by Isabelle. All ten new
modules certify, each with its LS4 steps uncertified, as every
module (G12 §2.9). Three do not certify, as at G11:
RulesFloorNV_rev5, Confinement, Confinement_A1;
restructuring deferred (item 74). Route by route: H6.
Thirteen cited by digest in ADR-0046 §4, two frozen from G9,
six from G10, two from G11 (G11 §3); frozen from G12 on:
nothing new, every module and proof added since cited only
by Proposed or pending text (G12 §3). A change is a
successor module with a successor proof. proof-sync.sh
reports any proof whose specification moved, and any results
file citing a prover other than the pin's; at G12 it exits 0,
where at G11 it exited 1 (G12 §2.9).
Proved holds of every behaviour of the module, for every
constant its assumptions admit. It is not a claim about
mechanism/ (T-0045-28) and replaces no mutation row
(ADR-0046 §2). Certified is not verified (G11 §8).
A proved TLA+ module, a function of the reference, or the
floor. The TLA+ text, its TLAPS proof and the Rust stay
canonical: Lean proves again, of what its Lean states
Sixteen modules as Lean transition systems; the theorems of
their 15 proof modules by induction on the reachable states,
the step TLAPS hands to LS4. Among them the three that do
not certify, every step kernel-checked, of the encoding.
admit.rs's floor_gate and compose, their call site and the
topak-floor wrapper: the whole decision proved a Decide
step of FloorComposition, on Cedar's rule as the engine
premise (R2). clock.rs's subtracting interval: the margin
moves expiry earlier, never later. Two models of apply,
replayed against the traces. Read beside the Rust; pinned,
not frozen; stale at G12, as at G11 (item 103).
The genesis floor, the floor in force (emergency, R3) and
the stage the reference links (workflow, not in force), in
cedar-spec v4.13.0's syntax: totality as one theorem of the
model's proved validator soundness; the 62, 107 and 123
cases under the model's authorizer; witnesses per action.
The sync fails if the reference links a floor no file states.
Lean 4.33.1, kernel libleanshared 5a23395d981dbeeb…,
pinned by tools/LEAN-PIN; installed through elan by
tools/install-lean.sh, not tracked. In ADR-0045's
Annex A since Batch 36.
Each results.sh: a clean build, #print axioms of 140
theorems, and leanchecker --fresh replaying every
constant, because the axiom list alone misses a declaration
added past the kernel. Byte for byte. tools/lean-sync.sh
checks every digest against the tree and the pin; at G12, as
at G11, it exits 1 for mechanism/lean's three series, by the
custodian's decision, now ratcheted in CI (G12 item 103).
Nothing under the three packages changed since G11;
proved modules without an encoding went from nine to
nineteen (item 107).
Proved in Lean holds of the encoding, transcription or
statement, read against what it states. Not a refinement:
T-0045-28 is unchanged; derived premises carry the second
route, and no stage is discharged through Lean (ADR-0053
In force: floor/proposed/emergency-floor.cedar, 28 policies, 107
cases, built by build.py from genesis-floor.cedar (17, 62) in three
gated stages, labels (20, 74), control (29, 106), emergency;
genesis-values.json (placeholders). Ratified when the bootstrap
reviewer finds it fit (ADR-0030 A3). A fourth stage, workflow (30, 123), is
Proposed with ADR-0054 and not in force.
Totality, non-vacuity, discrimination, every entry matters, routing, four
negative controls, three checker controls (ADR-0030 §5);
floor/proposed/run-gates.py runs them unchanged on a stage, then
routing controls for the stage's new entries.
Keeps each query, runs cvc5 with proofs, binds the proof to the query's
own declarations and assertions; forwards unsat only once the checker
accepts. Anything else is unknown, a failure.
ethos 8dc85c4 against the CPC signature in tools/cpc/ (from cvc5
1.4.0). The solver is trusted for nothing (ADR-0030 A1, Batch 24).
Since B28 the same checker stands behind the certified proofs.
RESULT: all gates pass, in all four. workflow, 2026.10.08: 22 unsat
with a checked proof, 44 totality checks holds°, tree 4ffc4fade540ab64.
emergency, 2026.10.04: 15 unsat with a checked proof, 41 totality
checks holds° by cedar's folding (T-0045-3), none unchecked; evidence
tree 974f339662a5289d. A rerun reproduces each file byte for byte (G10
§3, G11 §3). Every stage's totality, and the genesis floor's, is also proved
in Lean, under cedar-spec's model (lane 3).
Compiled in by path, refused at startup unless its bytes match the gated
digests: the emergency stage from 2026.10.05 (A10–A12), and since
2026.10.08 the workflow stage, not in force, at the custodian's direction
(A16; item 102). Its 123 cases replay through the linked engine. The stage
files' opening comment is wrong, and false of the linked stage (item 91).
slm/ pipeline at rung 0: every record is declared (D-0035-1).

svg.text: Fails when a pinned file changes, or when the code cites a record that is
not pinned.
Review the change against the code; bring the code into line or register
the divergence in GAPS; replace the pin line. Whole-file pins trip on
History-only edits.

text.tspan: Drift: records and modules pinned by the reference
: what it checks, what must fail, what is proved and certified, and where its result is

svg.text: Forty-one modules and thirty-four proof modules (G12 §2.9, §9; ADR-0033 A20: G9's twenty and fifteen; at G10 Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency, Correlator, BreakGlass_A1 and NonComposition_A1, and seven proofs; at G11 Emergency_live and Coupling_live with their proofs, and Workflow and Mesh, then unproved; since, the command-chain overlay's eight with their proofs (2026.11.10), the proofs of Workflow and Mesh (2026.11.11), and Paxos with PaxosTrace

(2026.11.14), unproved; Trace_* files are generated and not counted). Properties are invariants checked under Mut = "none"; each mutation changes the mechanism, never the property, and must produce a counterexample; each Never… witness must be violated, which shows the behaviour it names is reachable. The proof column gives each proof module, its obligations (ADR-0046 §4) and whether its certified run certifies (A1; H6); its results files are

<Module>-proof-results-<date>.txt and <Module>-proof-cert-results-<date>.txt. Results files are dated and never change; every proof results file, and every module added since G9, regenerates from a script (G12 item 78, in part; spec/modules.tsv drives CI's TLC job over fifteen). Pinned means listed in mechanism/corpus-pins.sha256. The binding table has no rows yet for eighteen modules, the overlay's eight among them (G12 item 90).

text.tspan: 5 · The honesty layer: what none of the above claims

svg.text: G7 said, as every checkpoint since G3 had: "no theorem is proved". G8 was the first checkpoint under which a property of the corpus is proved, in ADR-0046 §1's sense; G10 is the first at which a proof can be certified (ADR-0046 A1), and it says in the same breath that a certified proof is not a verified one (G10 §8). G11 is the first at which the prover is known to be unsound, in two ways, and a second method proves the same theorems again (G11 §8). G12 is the first at which those two
cases are reported upstream, and the first with ten more proof modules, every one under a Proposed record (G12, "What G12 is").
Proved names a claim TLAPS discharged and the hypotheses it was discharged under: thirty-four modules' invariants, ten of them of Proposed records (G12
§8). Certified names a proof whose every obligation is closed by the prover's normalization, a checked proof or LS4: thirty-one of them. Checked names TLC's
evidence: the mutations and witnesses at small constants, since 2026.10.07 four leads-to properties, and since 2026.11.14 the consensus log's trace replay.
None is used of the running reference (ADR-0046 §1, A1). A fourth, since Batch 36: proved in Lean, of an encoding, a transcription or a statement, never
"proved" alone (ADR-0053 §1).
Trace validation is drift detection against a model of the code: tested paths only, and it cannot check ContainedMeansConfined; a checked gate proof certifies
an implication between two Cedar encodings, not the encoding (G8 §8). The theorem-to-premise table says what each property assumed.

text.tspan: Small constants; the prover as written

svg.text: "A property that holds at two principals and one epoch is evidence, not a proof" (T-0045-29, G5 §8): since B25 that residual bounds the mutations and witnesses
only. Model checking at practical constants: none yet (spec/README.md practice item 3; G10 §7, item 75 as at G9).
TLC and the prover are trust-root rows (T-0045-29, T-0045-31), trusted as written: no mutation of either is run. A certified proof still trusts the prover's
translation of an obligation into a query, its normalization, LS4, and the checker (G10 §3); three modules certify on nothing more than the prover as first
configured (item 74). And the translation is known to be unsound in two ways (ADR-0046 A2): a scan and a reading say no cited result rests on either, and
no check detects the first (item 104). Both are reported upstream (B39) and fixed upstream in part, in ff40755; the pin has both, and moving it is ADR-0077's
open decision, Proposed (G12 §2.6, §8).
"One record, six amendments and errata, three Lean packages, two liveness modules, two Proposed records with twelve pending amendments, two modules, a
floor stage and a rebuilt reference are one hand's, drafted, built and checked across five days" (G11 §4), as G10 said of the three days before it; and "twenty-two
Proposed records, four pending amendments, ten proof modules, a specification graph, a CI pipeline and a rung-1 run are one hand's, drafted, built and checked
across five weeks, with no second reader" (G12 §4). The certification wrapper, its driver, the scan and every result are the drafter's (B28, B37); so are the
consensus log's model and its traced simulation (A20, B40, "not reviewed by a reader other than the drafter").
The operational model was written from the code by the same hand: "a model written from the code by the same hand agrees with the code" (ToO §11.3).
Breaking it on purpose, one modelled thing at a time, is the check that it can disagree (A14; G10 §5).

text.tspan: What runs is neither checked nor proved

svg.text: "The invariants are proved, under named hypotheses, by the prover T-0045-31 ... Neither is a claim about the running reference"; "a Lean proof of the code is not
a proof of the code" (G11 §8, G12 §8). "What runs is not the specification" (ADR-0045 §5, R1): no refinement from the modules to the Rust exists and the build is
asserted, not reproduced: trust-root rows T-0045-28 to 30, for every deployment.
Operators.tla and Emergency.tla are tied to the reference by tests and no refinement (item 90); Workflow.tla and Mesh.tla by tests named after their
properties and by no trace (A16): "their modules are now proved; that does not ratify them" (G12 §8). Paxos.tla is written from replica.rs and replayed
against its runs: an operational model, checked and not proved, that "does not claim a refinement of Voting" (A20). The overlay's eight are of a design with no
floor and no code (G12 §8).

text.tspan: What the checks do not cover

svg.text: A holds° is cedar's own term folding with no query to check: in the emergency stage's run, all 41 totality checks rest on the engine's row (T-0045-3), not the
checker's (G9 item 69). For those 41, and the genesis floor's 23, a Lean proof under cedar-spec's model carries them since Batch 36 (ADR-0053 R3).
The CPC signature is cvc5's own formalization, trusted as written (G7 §4). The race in lease expiry had no property to violate: the clock is outside every
module, and it was found because a test failed one run in three under tracing, "and no proof would have found it" (ADR-0033 A13). Whether anything else a
replica keeps is recorded after the lock is released was not audited (item 96). No liveness property is proved: coupling's four are checked at small constants
(E4; item 105); five ENABLED invariants are proved, two for the emergency call and three in the overlay, under Proposed records (G12 §8). Paxos.tla states no
liveness; delivery after the network heals is the simulation's check alone.
Stage 1, trace validation: A5 (Batch 21), rerun at A6, widened at A7 and A8, not rerun at A10 to A12, and current with the tree again at A14; A15 changed
nothing apply does; behind it again since A16, which Mechanism.tla does not model, and not rerun at A19 or A20 (B40). The consensus log gained its own
stage one at A20, PaxosTrace.tla, run twice; it is of the simulation's host, not topak-node's. Stage 2, a Lean model with differential testing, and stage 3, its
compilation: "the chain proper", not begun (G12 item 56). "Of the refinement chain's three items, none is discharged" (A15). Proving two functions in Lean of a
transcription (ADR-0053, B36) discharges none of them either. Since R4 a Lean model of apply's seat and lease arms is proved to refine Seats and replayed
against every recorded trace: stage 2's shape for one module, with an oracle for the rest of apply, and not the stage (ADR-0053 §5). R5 narrows that oracle with
ADR-0039's checks and proves Coupling's properties of the result; still not the stage.
The reproducible build (T-0045-30) is untouched. Each addendum says which stage it discharges, and the rows leave Annex A only on that addendum.
